description: S2-B2 C-2 flow I TEST identity policy (C-2 plan v0.2 §3.2). Separate from the official S2B2-TRUST-POLICY.json, which this file never affects. Each record approves the Git blob SHA of .github/workflows/attest-sigtest.yml as a TEST signer. A signature accepted under this policy is reported as SIGTEST_IDENTITY_ACCEPTED only — never as PASS or as an accepted statement. Proposed by Claude in the C-2 PR; it takes effect only through the owner's explicit merge instruction (owner decision Q3, 2026-11-23). Only the owner changes this file (PR review + anchor re-approval).
